title: Improving Chain-of-Thought for Logical Reasoning via Attention-Aware Intervention
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the logical reasoning performance of LLMs across several well-known benchmarks (ProofWriter, PrOntoQA, Logical Deduction, FOLIO, GSM8k) using a novel attention-aware intervention method. It does not contain any component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
